title: skills(i18n): the action key table names the new table column label keys (resultDialog.columns / preflight.columns) from #34652
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG

Skills-docs follow-up for #34652 / PR #34915, filed by the seat as the claim template asks. Grading and `domain:*` belong to triage.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:skills · size XS
Blocked-by: #34652 (the keys exist only once PR #34915 merges)

## What

PR #34915 adds two translation bundle keys for an action answer's table column labels: `resultDialog.columns.<fieldPath>.<columnPath>` and `preflight.columns.<fieldPath>.<columnPath>`. These are siblings of the existing `resultDialog.fields.<path>` and `preflight.fields.<path>`. The published skill `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` has an action key table that lists the `fields` keys but not the new `columns` keys. An author following the skill would leave a table's column headers in English.

## Done when

The skill's action key table names both `columns` keys, with one example of a table answer whose column labels resolve in zh-CN. Its evals or line budget move only as that skill's rules require. This is a governed path (`skills/**`).
